sources.ls: Mars24 algorithm (Allison and McEwen 2000; https://www.giss.nasa.gov/tools/mars24/help/algorithm.html), computed in scripts/ls_mars24.py from the MODRDR TIMESTAMP at LMST 12:00 of each sol

filters.ambient_temp: AMBIENT_TEMP != -999 and last character of AMBIENT_TEMP_CONFIDENCE_LEVEL == "1"
filters.hour: LMST hour of the row; sol taken from LMST field; hourly value = mean of valid rows in that sol-hour

units.uv: W/m2 (UV_ABC max of the sol, any row != -999)
units.dTmax: K/h (largest hour-to-hour change in hourly mean GTS; dTh = starting hour)

sol_row_cols.ls: areocentric solar longitude (deg) at LMST 12:00 of the sol, Mars24 algorithm
sol_row_cols.a40/a55: same for ambient air temp (hours with valid data: ahrs)

meta.wind: no usable wind in period B (0 rows); do not display
